editions.text: The day added up to a quieter one at the station, with 189 feeder visits and 312 detections across 19 species, against week averages of 271.0 visits, 414.7 detections, and 20.1 species. The 312 heard detections were the lowest of the past seven days, and the visit count was second-lowest, behind 2026-10-17. Tufted Titmouse led the visual counts with 57 visits, and most of the regulars held, with Northern Cardinal, Carolina Chickadee, Blue Jay, and Eastern Towhee all recorded again. Blue Grosbeak and Gray Catbird, which appeared on several earlier days this week, were not recorded today. Eastern Screech-Owl returned after 17 days away, last recorded on 2026-10-04, with one probable visual. The audio source was switched repeatedly through the day, both in the early morning and the evening, and it has been changed many times since 2026-10-15, so the heard counts draw on a mix of microphones.
